references.text: John 10:35 directly quotes Psalm 82:6, where God refers to judges as 'gods' because the word of God came to them. This is the explicit reference Jesus uses to defend his claim that he is the Son of God.
John 10:34-36 forms the immediate context in which Jesus uses Psalm 82:6 as irrefutable proof (that Scripture cannot be broken) that he is not a liar when he calls himself the Son of God.
